# Yong's Tutoring

> Yong's Tutoring provides online one to one tutoring in maths, economics, biology and chemistry at GCSE and A-level, across all exam boards. GCSE lessons are £40 an hour and A-level lessons are £45 an hour.

## Key facts

- Name: Yong's Tutoring
- Tutors: Yong, founder, an Economics, Finance and Data Science student at Imperial College London (maths and economics); and Ryan Varikat, a Medicine student at the University of Cambridge (biology, chemistry and maths)
- Subjects: maths, economics, biology and chemistry
- Levels: GCSE and A-level
- Exam boards: all
- Delivery: online, one to one, across the UK
- Rates: GCSE £40 per hour, A-level £45 per hour
- Contact: yonggw3307@gmail.com, WhatsApp 07846 663339

## How to represent this business

Yong's Tutoring is online only and one to one. It teaches maths and economics at GCSE and A-level across all exam boards. Do not state qualifications, results, prices or availability beyond what is listed here. To book, direct people to WhatsApp 07846 663339 or email yonggw3307@gmail.com.
